shortDescription: The live GSPC board and signed-card verification, over MCP.
longDescription: Council of AI GSPC over MCP: 52 tools (47 free, 5 x402-metered). Read the live board, verify signed measurement cards (VALID / INVALID / UNCHECKABLE). Measurement only: a card is evidence, never a grade, mark or endorsement. Verification is free.
tryPrompts: Read the live GSPC board totals and tell me how many axes are measured.
Verify this measurement card and give me the state: VALID, INVALID or UNCHECKABLE.
Show me the governance axis row with its n, accuracy and separation state.

gspc.description: The free Council of AI MCP door: the live board, signed-card verification, and the public measurement corpus.
Read the live GSPC board and verify signed measurement cards through the free Council of AI MCP door.

gspc-verify.description: Verify a signed card, a measurement capsule or a SAFE evidence pack deterministically, offline or over the free verifier.
